## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

Record local checks, CI, and preview behavior. For UI changes, include a PyTurbo screenshot and explain fidelity checks against the external reference; do not commit Borland screenshots.

## Review

- [ ] Required checks pass
- [ ] Keyboard, mouse, and accessibility behavior verified as applicable
- [ ] Fidelity and browser limitations documented accurately
- [ ] No secrets or third-party proprietary assets
